notablePrerequisites: At least twelve creature cards in your graveyard.
description:
Tap Kiki-Jiki to create a token copy of Kraul Foragers with haste.
The token enters gaining you 12 life.
Pay 12 life to Treasonous Ogre to add {R}{R}{R}{R}.
Pay {1} to untap Staff of Domination and {3} and tap Staff of Domination to untap Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.
